meta.method: Sonker et al. 2022 Frequency Ratio applied to Aizawl District, Mizoram
meta.note: FR computed on 70% train landslide cells only. FRn = FR / max(FR) per factor. LSI = sum FRn over 17 factors. 22 NASA GLC points; many location_accuracy 1-50 km. Not a publishable map.

rainfall.title: Rainfall (CHIRPS mean annual)
rainfall.caveat: Continuous CHIRPS reclassed to 5 equal-area quantiles on AIZWAL\cap DEM. Not Sonker Sikkim mm breaks.

earthquake.title: Earthquake magnitude (Sonker reclass)
earthquake.caveat: Aizawl occupies only a subset of Sikkim magnitude classes (empty classes expected).

slope.title: Slope
slope.caveat: Sonker Table 1 slope bins transferred to Aizawl.

altitude.title: Altitude
altitude.caveat: Sikkim elevation bins; Aizawl is almost entirely classes 1-2.

tri.title: Topographic roughness index (TRI)
tri.caveat: WEAK: Aizawl terrain saturates class 5 (~99.97%). Near-constant FRn.

geology.title: Geology (GLiM)
geology.caveat: WEAK: 100% siliciclastic sedimentary (GLiM ss). Not GSI Mizoram formations. FR identically 1.

soil.title: Soil (India NBSS, not SoilGrids)
soil.caveat: India NBSS soil map reclassed to Sonker-style integer codes. Not Sikkim 1:50k texture units.

gravity.title: Simple Bouguer gravity anomaly
gravity.caveat: Continuous simple Bouguer (GGMplus dg - 0.1119*H) quantile-classed. Not digitized Ansari 2014 Sikkim Bouguer.

faults_dist.title: Distance to faults
faults_dist.caveat: GEM/open faults, not a complete GSI fault inventory.

sti.title: Stream transport index (STI)
sti.caveat: Sonker STI bins on Aizawl DEM hydrology.

spi.title: Stream power index (SPI)
spi.caveat: Sonker SPI bins; some low classes may be empty or rare.

roads_dist.title: Distance to roads
roads_dist.caveat: WEAK: almost all Aizawl cells are class 1 (dense OSM road network vs Sikkim bins).

lulc.title: LULC
lulc.caveat: ESRI IO annual LULC remapped to Sonker 6 classes. Forest dominates.

ndvi.title: NDVI
ndvi.caveat: WEAK: Sikkim alpine NDVI breaks; Aizawl forest saturates class 5 (~99.5%).
